viewer: Renters in 2026 with enough saved for 20% down on a home near the national median, deciding whether to buy now or keep renting.
decision: Buy a home and hold it about 10 years, or rent an equivalent home and keep the cash?
promise: Two identical people, one buys and one rents, replayed from every month since 1991 with real home prices, real rents and real mortgage rates: how often did buying win, and when did it lose?
title: Rent vs Buy a Home — Replayed Through Real History
thumbnail: Two front doors side by side, one with a SOLD sign, one with a FOR RENT sign / "2006 vs 2012"

characters.buyer: ILLUSTRATIVE: buys a $400,000 home in the start month, 20% down, 30-year fixed at that month's average rate.
characters.renter: ILLUSTRATIVE: same start month, same cash, rents an equivalent home and keeps the difference in cash.

audienceQuestionsNotAnswered.4: Investing the renter's savings in stocks is not modelled (only a T-bill variant).
